# FEX-Lambert v1.4

This directory vendors the two files required from Rody Oldenhuis's
[FEX-Lambert v1.4](https://github.com/rodyo/FEX-Lambert/releases/tag/v1.4).

- Upstream commit: `f220826e6ac688ae8dfd2e8c9374872e43ea9fb4`
- License: 2-clause BSD; see [License.txt](License.txt).

The source file retains its upstream name. Run 02 uses
`rpo2ds.solve_lambert` for zero-revolution transfers; Run 06 uses
`comet.lambert_branch` for zero- and multi-revolution transfers.
